<%= lc_prose do %>

Make room for the trip

A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.

Start with one clear decision, name the plan kyoto-weekend, then choose what comes next.

  • Choose a place to stay.

The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.

examples.title: Reading content
examples.erb:
<%= lc_prose do %>

Make room for the trip

A shared plan is easier to follow when each idea has room to breathe. Keep the essentials close and give a new topic a little more space.

Start with one clear decision, name the plan kyoto-weekend, then choose what comes next.

  • Choose a place to stay.
  • Set aside time for a slow morning.
  • Leave an afternoon open.

The best part of a plan is the space it leaves for a surprise.

Ready to begin?

Buttons and other app controls can opt out of reading styles.

<%= lc_button "Create a plan" %>
<% end %>

examples.title: Japanese reading
examples.erb:
<%= lc_prose lang: "ja" do %>

旅の計画に、少しの余白を。

みんなで予定を考えるときは、大切なことから順番に決めていきましょう。読みやすい行間と段落の間隔が、長い文章をたどる手助けになります。

最初に決めておきたいこと

  • 集合する場所と時間
  • みんなで分ける費用
  • 自由に過ごす時間

予定が変わったら、グループにひとこと。少しの共有で、旅がもっと気軽になります。

何もしない時間も、旅の楽しみのひとつです。

<% end %>

blocks.title: Application header
blocks.description: A glass header with navigation, an account menu and room for your brand.
notes: Replace the sample brand, links and account actions with your application's content.
Keep navigation destinations as links and account actions in the menu. The header's layout and scroll behavior live in the example files.

files.source:
<%# locals: (brand:, home: "/", home_label:, links: [], label: "Main", width: "max-w-5xl", navigation_class: "sm:flex") %> <%# links: [[label, url, current], …]. The block's content renders the actions at the end of the bar. %>
" aria-hidden="true"> <%= brand %> <% if links.any? %>
<% links.each do |text, url, current| %> <%= lc_button_link_to text, url, variant: :ghost, size: :sm, class: "aria-[current=page]:bg-accent", aria: { current: ("page" if current) } %> <% end %>
<% end %>
<%= yield %>

blocks.title: Documentation layout
blocks.description: A sidebar, page content and an "On this page" list, with a collapsible menu on phones.
notes: Render it as a layout: pass the sidebar and contents lists as locals and the page as the block. This documentation site uses it for every guide and component page.
Mark the current page with current: true so the sidebar sets aria-current. The contents list appears from the xl breakpoint.

files.source:
<%# locals: (navigation:, contents: nil, menu_label: "Menu", width: nil) %> <%# navigation: the sidebar, usually lc_nav_list. contents: an optional "On this page" list for wide screens. %>
<%= navigation %>
<%= menu_label %><%= lc_icon "chevron-down", options: { class: "size-4 transition-transform group-open/nav:rotate-180", "aria-hidden": true } %>
<%= navigation %>
<%= yield %>
<% if contents %>
<%= contents %>
<% end %>
